Hi Evan — welcome (and thanks for the quick turnaround). Looping in Monica from Finance to handle PO/invoice routing. Below are the items we can share immediately and next steps: 

1) DPA — please find attached our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf). If your legal team needs redlines, send them to legal@redwood-inference.com and we'll route.

2) SOC 2 — current report (Type II) is hosted behind an authenticated link; here is a secure download link for procurement review:
   https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/soc2-report-2028.pdf
   Note: link expires in 14 days. If you need direct access or an NDA, let us know.

3) Subprocessors — attached CSV contains our active subprocessors and primary data categories we share with them (redwood_subprocessors_2028-07.csv).

4) PO & invoicing — Monica, can you confirm billing contact and remittance details for Redwood? Evan, below is our standard PO flow:
   - Email PO to invoices@redwood-inference.com (this mailbox is monitored by Finance)
   - Reference Redwood vendor ID: RDW-4592 on the PO
   - For expedited processing, include contact: monica.patel@redwood-inference.com and the expected invoice frequency (monthly/one-time)

5) Tax forms — we don't require a supplier W9 from you to accept payments, but if you have a vendor W9 on file we can store it for our records. You may attach it in reply or upload to the shared link Monica will provide.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.3.pdf; redwood_subprocessors_2028-07.csv

Next steps: Monica will send a short PO routing checklist and DocuSign link for the DPA if signatures are needed. Happy to run a short call if there are follow-ups.

— Sergio
